value.rationale: The complete Chermak–Delgado and centralizer lattices are canonical and natural structural group invariants. Ring thickening yields the entire nonfree-submodule lattice rather than the known finite-field subspace lattice. The explicit exact measure defect characterizes every extremizer, with sharp monotonicity boundary and striking 67 vs 15 vs 212 vs 23 sample structures. This is an infinite-family structural classification with plausible use for nonsemisimple p-group subgroup geometry, not a mechanical reparameterization or a single arbitrary finite sample.
